description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI de Périgueux - Données géolocalisées produites par le SIG Directive inondation du territoire à risque d'inondation de Périgueux is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The flood maps and flood risk maps of the TRI were approved on 3 December 2014 by prefectural order No. 2014337-0002. The Floods Directive geostandard describes the base of geographical data produced on territories at significant flood risk (TRIs) and mapped for reporting purposes for the EU Floods Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "New Aquitaine: TRI de Périgueux - Geolocated data produced by the GIS Flooding Directive of the territory at risk of flo" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include TRI, Directive inondation, risque, surfaces inondables, inondation, Périgueux. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
